name: tunetune
description: Work with your Agent to train, test, and improve small models for your own tasks.

interface.longDescription:
Work with your Agent to train, test, and improve small models for your own tasks. Your Agent researches approaches, proposes a plan and budget, calibrates tests, measures a baseline, and runs bounded experiments. Follow the study in the workbench and try your own inputs on verified local models. Results depend on the task, data, and available resources.

Open source: https://github.com/nanshine/tunetune
defaultPrompt: Help me train a small model that sorts my customer messages, starting in this folder.
Use TuneTune to train and evaluate a small model that tags my notes.
